summary: Completed backend + frontend end-to-end testing for AllergoLab. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passing (auth register/login/logout/me/duplicate/invalid/google-session validation, allergens list = 282, aggregate scenarios A-E per Algoritmo Allegato 2, reports CRUD). Frontend: full happy-path flow verified via Playwright — login as admin, patient form (with doctor default 'Duilio Brugnoni'), DualList search + category filter badges + multi-checkbox + add-selected + selected items + SISS suggestions (auto-refresh with 0090681.00), preview modal (edit/save/print buttons present), save report, storico tab shows saved report, clear-list works, logout returns to /.

issues: Radix Dialog console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Accessibility issue only, does not affect functionality — should add a (visually hidden) DialogTitle/Description in ReportModal.jsx.

action_items: (Minor / a11y) Add a DialogTitle (optionally VisuallyHidden) and aria-describedby to the ReportModal Dialog to silence Radix warnings and improve screen-reader support.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_dotenv timing is correct (before reading env). Good.
get_current_user cleanly excludes _id via projection. Good.
Cookies are httpOnly + Secure + SameSite=None — appropriate for the same-origin production preview URL.
seed_admin is idempotent and re-hashes password if changed — matches auth playbook.
algorithm.aggregate correctly handles all five scenarios; merge logic dedupes 009068D emitted twice (molecular>12 and total>60).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_ prefixed reports and one ephemeral test_<uuid>@example.com user; report is deleted at end of test. Registered test users remain in DB (small footprint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (14 tests, all passing in ~3s). It relies on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env (fallback reads /app/frontend/.env). Frontend E2E used the data-testids listed in the review request — all resolved. Only outstanding item is the Radix Dialog a11y warning.
